name: 83854 · Post Falls, ID
findings: ZIP 83854 (Post Falls) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83854 (Post Falls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83854 (Post Falls) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
